messages:
maya: Quick sync — planning the newsletter + nurture drip for the Q2 benchmark webinar launch. Goal: drive registrants, route inbound signal to SDRs, and run a tiny re-engage for dormant trial accounts. Ping if you care about send windows, segments, or subject lines.

oliver: Love it. Timeline? Are we sending a dedicated launch email + a 3-step nurture?

maya: Yes — dedicated launch on Tue 9am PT, follow-ups at +3d and +10d. Nurture paths: registered -> reminders; not-registered but active trial -> value-door email + webinar CTA; inactive (60d+) -> soft re-engage with benchmark highlights.

priya: For segments I propose: `registered`, `trial-active-7d`, `trial-inactive-60d`, `lead-warm` (clicked product content in last 30d). Suppress `unsubscribed`, `do-not-contact`, and `bounced`. Also verify suppression from recent support tickets.

ben: Subject line A/B test ideas (50/50 split):
```
A: See how customers cut inference cost 3x — webinar Tue
B: Live demo: reduce LLM latency and spend — join Tue
```
We should track opens -> CTA clicks -> register. If registered, route to SDR queue `webinar_registrants` with UTM campaign `q2-benchmark-webinar` and tag `intent:high`.

oliver: Send windows: for NA target 9am PT works. For EU subset we should schedule 9am CET (so sends shift Tue 6pm PT). Do we want a second hour window for APAC?

maya: Good call — APAC cohort gets Wed 10am SGT (stagger to avoid backend spikes). We'll create three scheduled batches.

priya: Quick note on personalization tokens — use `{{first_name}}`, `{{company}}`, and conditional `{{trial_end_date}}` for trial-active. If `trial_end_date` missing, fall back to 'your account'. Also ensure snippet for privacy language is present.

ben: Deliverability checklist before send: seed list checks, spam-scan subject/body, check for high-image-ratio, confirm DKIM/SPF passing, quarantine any recently reactivated addresses, and throttle to keep ESP reputation good.

maya: Agreed — I'll run the seed test this afternoon. Also want a 1% holdout for analytics baseline. Who can add the holdout flag in the audience export?

oliver: I can add `holdout_1pct=true` to the export. Also will include `sdr_owner` mapping based on MQL score and region.

launch-bot: Scheduled send created: `q2-benchmark-launch` -> Tue 09:00 PT (NA), Tue 18:00 PT (EU), Wed 10:00 SGT (APAC). Preview link: https://email-preview.internal/q2-benchmark-launch

priya: Can someone sanity-check the preview for token bleed and mobile render? I can do mobile.

ben: I'll run a subject line spam check and seed inboxes for NA/EU.

maya: Ownership: Maya = creative + copy final, Priya = segment exports + preview QA, Oliver = audience export + SDR routing, Ben = deliverability + tracking. Deadline for final assets: EOD Mon. If all good we'll unpause the scheduled sends.

oliver: Noted. I'll add a short playbook doc in the channel with the SDR routing mapping and MP webhook details.

priya: One more — add `utm_source=newsletter&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=q2-benchmark-webinar` to all CTA links and ensure calendar add link has `utm_content=calendar`.

maya: Perfect. If nobody objects I'm going to lock subjects and hero image by 3pm and push to preview seed. :thumbsup:

ben: No objections. :rocket:

launch-bot: Preview seeds delivered to internal list (10 addresses). All DKIM/SPF checks green.

maya: Great — thanks team. We'll regroup Tue morning to monitor open rates and early registrations.
